message: The ember target does not support late-prop: An Ember parent names each argument in its template, so it never adds one after mount, and the target does not make a component follow one that appears later: a parent that would add an argument late passes it from the start, `undefined` while it has no value.

The qwik target does not support late-prop: Qwik subscribes a `useComputed$` or a task only to the props the component holds when it reads them, so a derived value or a watcher that reads an optional prop the parent did not pass at mount, and passes later (a spread that gains the key), does not see it: the template does. Pass the prop from the start, `undefined` while it has no value.

The astro target does not support interactivity: Astro components render on the server only, and each render is a new instance: event handlers, template refs, watchers and lifecycle hooks never run, and state keeps its initial value.
